item.body:
### Summary

Check whether the legacy-app bug "Topic loading: a cancelled request must never complete the next load" exists in SwiftHFR (test on the lots named below) and fix it if so. Found by Bybifok (@moust4ki) in the legacy app.

### Scope

SwiftHFR work (from `docs/LOTS.md` "Issues to open" #7): One task per load, cancelled one cannot deliver; show at `DOMContentLoaded`; test with a fake page driver

Legacy commit: `be196f8` (see [ezzz/HFRnow#3](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/3)).

Status in LOTS.md: blocked (LOT-083 (#101)).

Found by Bybifok (@moust4ki); credit the finding in the fix (label `moust4ki aka bybifok finding`). Legacy fix: ezzz/HFRnow#3 (open).

- [ezzz/HFRnow#13](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/13) — backlog of the findings in LOTS.md (merged)

### Help wanted

@moust4ki, you found this one: would you like to take it? The work is to check whether the bug exists in SwiftHFR (a test on the lots above) and, if it does, to fix it, with the credit to you. Not written yet for topics: LOT-083 (#101) (topic reader) has not started; LOT-082 (#100)'s `ContentLoader` already applies the rule to lists. Verification waits for LOT-083 (#101).

To take it, comment `/claim <your session id>` (e.g. `/claim human/moust4ki`) and open a PR into `dev-swift` with `Closes #<this issue>` (AGENTS.md §8, CONTRIBUTING.md). If you would rather not, say so and a maintainer session will pick it up.

comments.body:
Verification (ext/bybifok-opus-1, Opus 5.5; not claimed, verification only): **already fixed in SwiftHFR; the `status: blocked` label is stale**, since LOT-083 is merged (#257, `ad071f0`). Legacy could let a cancelled topic request complete the next load and leave the topic on "Chargement…" (legacy fix `be196f8` in ezzz/HFRnow#3).

- **One task per load; a superseded or cancelled load never delivers.**
  - `TopicReaderModel.load` cancels the task in flight and bumps a generation, and `finish` drops any result whose generation is not the current one (`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift:169-193`, comment "issue #108").
  - Lists do the same through `ContentLoader` (`App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/ContentLoader.swift:18-41`).
- **Shown at DOMContentLoaded, current document only.** The web view reports readiness with the document's token, and `documentDidBecomeReady(token:)` ignores an older document (`TopicReaderModel.swift:147-151`).
- **Tests with a fake page source** (`FakeTopicPages`, `ReaderGate`):
  - `TopicReaderModelTests.aSupersededLoadNeverDelivers`: page 2 held, page 3 asked, page 3 shown, token 2;
  - `.aCancelledLoadNeverDelivers`;
  - `.onlyTheCurrentDocumentCanBecomeReady`;
  - for lists: `ContentLoaderTests.aSupersededLoadCannotOverwriteTheNewerOne`, `.aCancelledLoadIsNotAnError`, `.cancelStopsTheLoadAndDropsItsResult`.

Suggest closing this issue on this evidence.
